about: The marked-up screenshots of the docs pages. Made by scripts/shots.mjs from raw screenshots kept outside the repository; see README.md, 'The docs pages and their screenshots'. Coordinates are CSS pixels of the raw screenshot.

shots.alt: The Export and Settings buttons at the top right of the Round Turn Monitor window in NinjaTrader, with the Export button marked.
Roundturn's dialog "Where are these trades from?" with NinjaTrader: Round Turn Monitor log chosen, its reminder to choose an Export file or the log, and the Choose files button.

Roundturn's preview of a Round Turn Monitor log: the NinjaTrader account to import, the counts of round turns, the things to check with a button to use the add-on's commission rate, and the Import button.
Roundturn's dialog "Where are these trades from?" with Tradovate: Performance report chosen, the time zone the file is read in with a link to change it, and the Choose files button.
TradeSea's panel under the chart: the Orders tab open, the Filled view selected, a page of ten filled orders, and the Export button with the page count at the bottom right.
Close-up of TradeSea's Accounts, Orders, Positions and pSpark tabs, and the All, Open, Filled and Cancelled views, with Orders and Filled selected.
Close-up of the bottom right of TradeSea's Orders list: the Export button, Page 1 of 2, and the arrows to the previous and next page.
Roundturn's dialog "Where are these trades from?" with TradeSea: Orders (Filled) chosen, its reminder to export every page, and the Choose files button.
Roundturn's preview of two TradeSea files: 17 filled orders making 5 trades, the commissions the files add up to, a button to use TradeSea's rate, and the Import button.

Roundturn's dialog "Where are these trades from?" with Other platform (converted with an AI chatbot) chosen, a net P&L typed from the statement, the Copy prompt and See the prompt buttons, and the Choose file button.

Roundturn's preview of the chatbot's file: 5 round turns, all new, none already imported and no errors, then Check against your statement, with the file's gross, fees and net P&L, the statement's figure, and the line saying the two match.
The card "1 row cannot be imported" in Roundturn's preview: line 5's gross P&L of 20.00 is not what the prices make, because 1 CL short from 60.15 to 59.95 is 200.00 at $1000 a point.
Roundturn's Preferences in Settings: the time zone times are shown in, the zone Tradovate files are written in, and when a trading day starts.
Roundturn's Prop accounts in Settings, with sample accounts: each account's stage, size, progress to its target and net P&L, and the Add account button.
An account's Firm rules tab: a search for the firm, program, size and phase, and the rule sets in force on the account's purchase date, the latest marked Suggested.
Roundturn's Accounts tab with sample accounts: each account's balance, net P&L, status (Breached, Payout ready, OK, No rules set), a bar from breach to goal, payout progress and consistency.
The top of Roundturn's Dashboard with sample data: the filter bar, then net P&L after fees, win rate, profit factor, average win and loss, expectancy and max drawdown.

The top of a trade's page in Roundturn, with sample data: the contract, side, time and account, the Share button, Previous and Next, and the trade's net P&L, gross, fees, points, hold time and trading day.
A trade's tags, grouped by Setup, Mistake and Emotion with one chosen, the Add tag button, and its screenshots with a place to drop or paste more.
Roundturn's Data and privacy settings: Download my data, which makes one ZIP file of everything, and Delete my account.
